subject: science
intro: Individuals of the same kind of organism are not all exactly alike; they have small differences called variations. Some variations can give an individual an advantage, meaning they help it survive, find a mate, or reproduce. For example, a rabbit whose fur color blends in with its surroundings is harder for predators to see, so it may survive longer. A bird with brighter feathers may attract a mate more easily. Using evidence about how a variation helps, we can explain why some individuals do better than others.

items.prompt: In a snowy area, white rabbits blend in with the snow while brown rabbits stand out. Explain how the white rabbits' variation gives them an advantage.

steps: Blending in makes a rabbit harder for predators to see.
White fur blends with snow, so white rabbits are harder to spot than brown ones.
Being harder to see, white rabbits are more likely to survive, so their variation gives a survival advantage.
solution.answer: White fur blends with the snow, so predators spot those rabbits less, giving them a better chance to survive.

items.prompt: A male bird with brighter feathers attracts a mate more easily than a dull-colored male. How does this variation help?

steps: Finding a mate is needed to reproduce.
The brighter feathers attract mates more easily than dull ones.
So the brighter-feathered bird has an advantage in finding a mate and reproducing.
solution.answer: Brighter feathers help the bird attract a mate more easily, giving it an advantage in reproducing.

items.prompt: Why do some individuals of the same species survive better than others?

steps: Individuals have small variations in their characteristics.
Some variations, like helpful colors or faster speed, give an advantage in their environment.
Individuals with those helpful variations survive and reproduce better than others.
solution.answer: Because some have variations that give an advantage, such as better camouflage or speed, so they survive and reproduce better.

steps: Individuals of the same species are not identical.
A variation is a small difference in a characteristic among those individuals.
solution.answer: A small difference in a characteristic among individuals of the same species.

items.prompt: Among cheetahs, some run faster than others. Use evidence to explain how this variation could be an advantage.

steps: Cheetahs catch prey by running them down.
A faster cheetah can catch more prey than a slower one, which is evidence of an advantage.
With more food, the faster cheetah is more likely to survive and reproduce.
solution.answer: Faster cheetahs catch more prey, which helps them survive and reproduce, so the speed variation is an advantage.

items.prompt: Two plants of the same kind differ: one has deeper roots. In a dry area, explain how this variation could help it.

steps: Deeper roots can reach water that is farther down in the soil.
In a dry area, the plant with deeper roots can get water when shallow-rooted plants cannot.
So the deeper-rooted plant is more likely to survive and reproduce, an advantage from its variation.
solution.answer: Deeper roots reach more water in a dry area, so that plant is more likely to survive and reproduce.
